title: IPv6 dual-stack and configurable bind address
description: Server hardcodes 0.0.0.0:8080 (IPv4 only, non-configurable). Fix: bind to [::]:8080 for dual-stack (IPv4+IPv6), make address/port configurable via BAIZE_BIND_ADDR env var with sensible default. Update log message. Clients are already address-agnostic.
